bhsa.name: Biblia Hebraica Stuttgartensia Amstelodamensis
bhsa.description: Hebrew Bible with linguistic annotation by ETCBC.
bhsa.note: 2021 feature files match the pinned census; c is an older frozen version.

cuc.name: Copenhagen Ugaritic Corpus
cuc.description: Ugaritic and other texts from Ugarit, with sign- and word-level annotations.
cuc.note: The 0.4.0 release expands the corpus; node identifiers are version-specific.

syriac.name: ETCBC Syriac literature
syriac.description: Morphologically annotated classical Syriac literary texts.
syriac.note: The upstream README describes data version 0.92.

peshitta.name: Peshitta (Old Testament)
peshitta.description: Syriac Old Testament with ETCBC text annotation.
peshitta.note: The 0.2 feature files match the pinned census.

syrnt.name: Syriac New Testament
syrnt.description: Syriac New Testament, including SEDRA-derived annotations.
syrnt.note: The 0.1 feature files match the pinned census.

extrabiblical.name: ETCBC extra-biblical Hebrew
extrabiblical.description: Non-Masoretic Hebrew texts, including inscriptions and other writings related to the Hebrew Bible.
extrabiblical.note: The 0.2 feature files match the pinned census.

tlhdig-tf.name: Thesaurus Linguarum Hethaeorum digitalis
tlhdig-tf.description: Text-Fabric conversion of the digital Hittite text corpus.
tlhdig-tf.note: Latest published TF release uses TLHdig source 0.3. Original source freshness is a separate question.

pseudepigrapha.name: Online Critical Pseudepigrapha
pseudepigrapha.description: Text-Fabric conversion of critical editions of biblical pseudepigrapha and manuscript variants.
pseudepigrapha.note: Release v1.1.0 changes eight TF features, including manuscript metadata.

assyrian-royal-inscriptions.name: Assyrian royal inscriptions (ORACC)
assyrian-royal-inscriptions.description: Text-Fabric corpus of RIAO and RINAP royal inscriptions.
assyrian-royal-inscriptions.note: Royal-inscription release v1.0.0 remains separate from native-v0.1.0 (Sumerian and medical corpora). Original source freshness is a separate question.

OLiA.note: Reference model file's latest commit is d3bd4f1aef9047b33186bfb2a1795401f3f1a4a6; packaged lock exists for selected terms.

OntoLex-Lemon.note: Core OWL blob matches upstream (10783b4c747bbc5f08fbae8f4169d6e02fc22565). Revised core is under development; selected terms have a pinned research lock.

CIDOC CRM.note: 7.4 (August 2026) is a draft; 7.1.3 remains the official ISO-corresponding release.

SKOS.note: Stable W3C Recommendation; publication age does not imply obsolescence.
